news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 0.7% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 0.7% per year for the foreseeable future. Minor Risk Dividend is not well covered by cash flows (129% cash payout ratio).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹9.84 (vs ₹9.56 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.84 (up from ₹9.56 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹127.2b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹17.3b (up 2.9% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (down from 15% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.9% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 9.2% growth forecast for the Insurance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 34% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
